evidence_class: independent geography and temporal endpoint; literature-outcome-aware; not pristine fresh confirmation
central_hypothesis: Among species whose complete historical source identities can be reconstructed response-independently, exact configuration of historically occupied source islands contains future colonization information beyond historical source count, nearest historical source, diffuse Euclidean source pressure, recipient-island state and species/pair traits; topology-specific gain should be strongest where response-free finite-source configuration sensitivity is high.

causal_order.rationale: historical source occupancy temporally precedes every future colonization outcome and is not a heldout future response

spatial_validation.coordinate_system: EUREF-FIN original coordinates from t0-safe columns
spatial_validation.block_rule: 10-km fixed EUREF grid cells: floor(Euref_X_original/10000) x floor(Euref_Y_original/10000)
spatial_validation.block_id: SHA256 of integer grid-x,grid-y with prefix SWF_ and first 12 hex digits
spatial_validation.pilot_assignment: SHA256('sw-finland-v1.165-pilot|' + block_id), ascending; first ceil(20%) blocks

source_operator.graph: minimal connected symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor graph on all 471 t0 island centres
source_operator.k_rule: smallest integer k>=1 yielding a connected graph
source_operator.edge_weight: Euclidean distance in EUREF-FIN metres converted to km
source_operator.kernel_scale: type-7 median of positive selected graph edge lengths
source_operator.source_set: exact reconstructed historical occupied-source islands for v1.164-eligible species only; target excluded defensively

required_properties: exact counts in five actual-edge-length quintile bins
same actual-graph kernel scale for source pressure

R0: full prospectively frozen recipient-island state from safe metadata, with ridge regularization rather than outcome-based variable selection
Gowdis_traits as pair-specific t0-safe historical recipient-community trait dissimilarity
R1_add: broad spatial coordinates and external surrounding-land variables
R3_add: recomputed historical source count from exact t0 source identity
recomputed nearest Euclidean historical source distance from exact t0 source identity
diffuse Euclidean historical source pressure from exact t0 source identity
reference_ladder.fitting: deterministic pooled ridge logistic regression; lambda=1; no future-outcome hyperparameter tuning

finite_source_sensitivity.M: number of eligible historical source positions in the frozen island universe excluding target
finite_source_sensitivity.n: exact reconstructed historical occupied-source count for the focal eligible species
finite_source_sensitivity.H_i: sigma_i^2/mu_i^2 across response-independent graph-kernel weights from target i to all possible source islands
finite_source_sensitivity.computation_timing: fully frozen from t0 state before any future outcome access

pilot_use.future_outcomes_opened: pilot spatial blocks for v1.164 exact-source eligible species only, one shot, after t0/graph/null freeze
purpose: fit the frozen R0-R3-C and null-C models

confirmatory_primary.endpoint: successful colonization rows (outcome=1) among frozen v1.164 exact-source eligible potential-colonization events
confirmatory_primary.P2_topology_specificity: equal-confirmatory-block mean successful-event binary-log-loss(actual C)-mean binary-log-loss(20 rewired C models)
confirmatory_primary.support_rule: P1 point and 95% block-bootstrap upper bound <0 AND P2 point and 95% block-bootstrap upper bound <0
confirmatory_primary.minimum_success_support: at least 5 confirmatory spatial blocks and at least 50 successful colonization events; otherwise terminal non-estimable

mechanistic_secondary.test: actual-minus-rewired successful-event contrast is more negative above than below the response-free median S_i(n), with median frozen over all confirmatory prediction rows before outcome access

anti_selection: do not treat archive rows omitted by the original complete-case modelling workflow as historical presences
do not admit a species without response-independent exact historical source identity
do not use published AIC-selected final model as the Structural reference
do not tune graph k, kernel scale, block size, null ensemble or S threshold using recent outcome
do not alter source-count eligibility after pilot outcome
do not use pilot effect direction to modify confirmatory scoring
do not call a favourable result pristine fresh confirmation

response_boundary.t0_projection_gate: requires committed v1.167 header freeze, byte-level outcome-opaque routing, and v1.164 exact-source completeness gate

eligibility_gate.exact_identity_rule: known archived historical-absence row count + response-independently recovered historical occupied-source count == 471
eligibility_gate.incomplete_archive_species: exclude before pilot/future outcome access; omitted rows are never treated as historical presences
eligibility_gate.zero_historical_source_species: exclude because graph-source features are undefined
eligibility_gate.if_minimum_not_met: terminal pre-outcome STOP/HOLD; no future colonization outcome access
